title: The transient link bracket - every transient POWER-STATE recomputed as the S-14(c) two-branch bracket
authority: HYPOTHESIS_LEDGER.md P5-8 (link-function ruling) + S-14(c) + S-15; queue rank 1 of Popper round 4
run_status: FIRST-RUN. No number in this file has been produced before. Arithmetic only; no new data, no new statistic, no download.
scope_constraint: The K-034 10-200x excess is used here ONLY as calibration data for power arithmetic. It remains logged-unclaimed per R2-2 and P5-8 and is not a finding of this artifact. This artifact RE-PRICES; it does not RE-RULE. No ADMIT/DEFER verdict in P4-3 is touched.

branchS.definition: R = exp(dtau/Asigma) over the S-14 bracket {0.03, 0.10, 0.15} MPa, retained ONLY as a lower bound on response
branchS.source: COLLECTED from k034_power.csv (columns dTau_min_kPa_Asigma*), which reproduces the K34-3 table exactly; not re-derived

branchE.form: R(sigma) = exp(a) * sigma_kPa**b  (quasi-Poisson GLM, log link, offset log(expected), regressor log sigma)
branchE.response_data: K-034 primary reading: 5 d window, M >= 1.5, distance-gate survivors, n_bg > 0

AB.envelope_note: slope held at the mean-link b; intercept set to the 90th percentile of log(RR_c) - b*log(sigma) with RR_c=(n_post+0.5)/(expected+0.5)

branchE.class_C_ruling: UNMEASURED per S-15. Class-C slope b = 0.299 with cluster-bootstrap CI [-0.78, 2.60] spanning 0, median observed RR = 0.78 (< 1). Branch E is NOT quoted at a non-geothermal receiver.

status_rules.POWERED: band max >= adverse Branch-S MDA (Asigma = 0.15) AND >= mean Branch-E MDA
status_rules.UNDERPOWERED: band max below both branches MDA AND inside the Branch-E fitted support
status_rules.POWER_INDETERMINATE: branches disagree, or band max lies below the Branch-E support where Branch E is UNMEASURED (S-15)
status_rules.NOT_AMPLITUDE_LIMITED: the POWER-STATE contains no stress-to-response conversion; the bracket does not bind
status_rules.reference_floor_justification: used only where the entry declares no MDM; equals the modulation floor the family itself quotes (K-063 4-12%, K-065 5.6%). Flagged per row.

deviations: D1. Popper P5-8 characterises Branch E as the OPTIMISTIC response. The mean empirical link is not optimistic everywhere: the power law (b = 0.81) is FLATTER than the exponential, so Branch S at Asigma = 0.03 predicts MORE response than Branch E above ~40 kPa, and the branches CROSS near 15-20 kPa. Two Branch-E variants are therefore reported: the mean link (primary) and a q90 optimistic envelope. The bracket is [most optimistic, most pessimistic] across all branch variants, computed per row rather than assumed.

D2. The 10-200x excess quoted in P5-8 is a per-firing-cell ratio, not the pooled mean response. The count-weighted mean link over all class-A+B pairs predicts R = 2.76 at the 33.8 kPa certified floor, against Branch S(0.15) = 1.25 - a factor of ~2.2, not 10-200x. The larger factors live in individual cells (Landers -> cedar_city_ut RR = 204 at 46 kPa). This is a property of the fit, reported, not claimed.

D3. Branch-E support is [7.1, 346.9] kPa. Every entry whose band lies below 7.1 kPa is priced POWER-INDETERMINATE by extrapolation refusal (S-15), not by a computed MDA. This is the mechanism by which K-059s 3 kPa gate and K-072s 1-5 kPa band move.

D4. Entry detection floors R_min are entry-declared where the POWER-STATE states an MDM or rate ratio, DERIVED as 2.8/sqrt(N_exposed) where the entry states only an N, and set to the REFERENCE floor 1.05 otherwise. Provenance is printed per row. No floor was invented silently.

D5. Overdispersion in the Branch-E fit is severe (Pearson dispersion = 107). Naive GLM p-values are not trusted; quasi-Poisson and cluster-by-source (4 clusters) standard errors and a 4000-draw cluster bootstrap are reported instead. With only four sources the cluster CI is wide by construction and that width is the finding about our own ignorance that S-14(c) asks to be put in the headline.

D6. Six of the 54 pairs are S-15 UNMEASURABLE at the primary reading (n_bg = 0); k034_power.csv flags 14 of 54 unmeasurable under its own floor. The fit uses the 48 measurable-by-n_bg pairs (30 class A+B, 18 class C); the per-cell MDA summary uses the 40 flagged measurable.
verification: Branch-S per-cell MDA summary over all 40 measurable cells reproduces the K34-3 table to 3 significant figures: 0.03 MPa best/median/worst 22.3/50.4/89.5 kPa; 0.10 MPa 74.2/168/298; 0.15 MPa 111/252/447.
Branch-S identity checked: dTau_min_kPa_Asigma0.15 == 150 * ln(R_min_80pct) for every measurable cell.
Max abs deviation of that identity: 5.68e-14 kPa.
